book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: وإجت الرسايل، وحدة ورا وحدة، من نورفولك.
sentences.en: And the messages came, one after another, from Norfolk.

sentences.ar: كيوبت بيلاقيها عالباب، وعالمزولة، وعالحيط، وبينسخها، وبيبعتها.
sentences.en: Cubitt found them on the door, on the sundial, on the wall, copied them, and sent them.
And Holmes spread them on the table, and counted, and compared.

sentences.ar: قال: بالإنجليزي، أكتر حرف هو E.
sentences.en: He said: in English, the commonest letter is E.

sentences.ar: فالرجل اللي بيتكرر أكتر، هو E.
sentences.en: So the man who recurs most is E.

sentences.ar: وبعد E، تجي T، A، O، I، N.
sentences.en: And after E come T, A, O, I, N.
But they are close, and the work is hard.

sentences.ar: وبعدين إجت رسالة من كلمة وحدة، خمس حروف، وأولها وآخرها E.
sentences.en: And then came a message of one word, five letters, beginning and ending with E.
Holmes said: lever? Never? Elsie!
And he had L, S, I.

sentences.ar: وقبل إلسي، كلمة من أربع حروف، آخرها E: COME.
sentences.en: And before Elsie, a four-letter word, ending in E: come.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، الرسالة الأولى، كلها، بحروفه الجديدة: AM HERE ABE SLANEY.
sentences.en: And then, the first message, whole, with his new letters: am here, Abe Slaney.
Holmes said: Abe Slaney.
An American name.
And he is here.

sentences.ar: وبعت برقية لصاحب بشرطة نيويورك، وسأله: مين آب سلاني؟
sentences.en: And he sent a telegram to a friend at the New York police, and asked: who is Abe Slaney?
And the next message came: at Elriges.
Holmes said: a farm.
Near Cubitt.
He is telling her where he is.

sentences.ar: وإجا الجواب من نيويورك: أخطر مجرم بشيكاغو.
sentences.en: And the answer came from New York: the most dangerous crook in Chicago.

sentences.ar: وبنفس الساعة، وصلت آخر رسالة من كيوبت.
sentences.en: And that same hour, the last message came from Cubitt.
A new message, and long.

sentences.ar: هولمز فكها بدقايق، ووقف، ووجهه تغير.
sentences.en: Holmes deciphered it in minutes, and stood, and his face changed.

sentences.ar: قال: ELSIE PREPARE TO MEET THY GOD.
sentences.en: He said: Elsie, prepare to meet thy God.
Watson, the first train to Norfolk.
Now.
And we ran to the station, and the train had gone.
And the next in two hours.

sentences.ar: وهولمز قعد بالمحطة، وما حكى كلمة.
sentences.en: And Holmes sat in the station, and said not a word.

sentences.ar: وبمحطة نورفولك، سألنا عن كيوبت، وناظر المحطة قال: ما سمعتوا؟
sentences.en: And at the Norfolk station, we asked about Cubitt, and the stationmaster said: have you not heard?
Mr. Cubitt was killed last night.
And his wife wounded, between life and death.
And Holmes went grey.
He said: we were a day late.
And on the way to the house, he said nothing.
And at the house, the local inspector said: simple.
His wife shot him, and shot herself.

sentences.ar: المسدس بينهم عالأرض، وفيه رصاصتين ناقصات.
sentences.en: The revolver between them on the floor, with two shots gone.

sentences.ar: والباب مقفول من جوا، والشباك مقفول.
sentences.en: And the door locked from inside, and the window shut.
Holmes said: and the servants, what did they hear?

sentences.ar: قالوا: طخة قوية، وبعدها بشوي طخة تانية.
sentences.en: They said: a loud shot, and a little after, a second.
Holmes said: a loud shot.
Meaning two together.
